Model weights
-------------
The ``Cnn14_DecisionLevelMax`` checkpoint itself is NOT vendored.  It is
downloaded at first run from Zenodo (record 3987831) and verified against a
pinned SHA-256 digest before use.  The weights are published by the same
author under the terms stated at
https://github.com/qiuqiangkong/audioset_tagging_cnn

The AudioSet class-label CSV is published by Google under CC-BY-4.0.


Modifications made when vendoring
---------------------------------
The vendored code is not a verbatim copy.  Behaviour-preserving changes:

* Removed ``os.system('wget ...')`` auto-download calls.  Upstream
  interpolated a filesystem path directly into a shell command line, which is
  a command-injection vector and additionally requires ``wget`` (absent on
  Windows).  Downloads are handled by ``monitor.model_cache`` with digest
  verification.
* ``torch.load(..., weights_only=True)`` — upstream used unrestricted pickle
  deserialisation, which is arbitrary code execution on a tampered checkpoint.
* Removed the module-level ``import matplotlib.pyplot``.  It was unused at
  runtime but forced matplotlib (and Pillow) into the shipped binary.
* Removed the module-level read of ``~/panns_data/class_labels_indices.csv``
  and its implicit network fetch; labels are now loaded from an explicit path.
* Removed training-only code paths (SpecAugmentation, mixup, weight
  initialisation) that cannot execute during inference.
* Removed the unused ``Cnn14``/``AudioTagging`` tagging model, ``DFT``,
  ``ISTFT``, ``Enframe`` and ``Scalar``.
* Replaced ``print()`` with the standard ``logging`` module.
* Added explicit XPU/CUDA/CPU device selection and type annotations.

The numerical behaviour of the retained inference path is unchanged; this is
enforced by ``tests/test_vendor_panns_parity.py``.
